note: Curated, human-reviewed observations. Derived flags are appended by tools/flags.py on every build.

flags.item: Historical Leaguepedia removal report for Solid Gaming (#1071216; absent from the current fixture snapshot)
flags.detail: A Leaguepedia community-maintained Data page contains a dqteams entry for Solid Gaming and describes a Round 10 removal/forfeit. This repository has no linked Riot or organizer confirmation, so the reported removal and 0-1 settlement are unverified. Fixture #1071216 is absent from the current Hotspawn snapshot; four different current fixtures are quarantined based on this secondary-source record. Hotspawn settlement is unknown, and Hotspawn crowd shares are never used as win probabilities.

flags.item: Historical Galions vs Solary market/crowd comparison (captured 2026-10-21; not a current line)
flags.detail: A prior 2026-10-21 snapshot recorded an 86%/14% Hotspawn crowd split and a reported 52.2%/47.8% external-price consensus. This is a dated illustration only, not current odds or an independently revalidated quote; use the current match list and source pages for live availability. Crowd share is not used in the probability model.

flags.item: Stale fixture-ID association in a prior placeholder-odds report (#1079080)
flags.detail: An earlier manual note associated fixture ID #1079080 with Bushido Wildcats vs Misa Esports and a Turkish Academy League placeholder-price case. The current Hotspawn snapshot assigns #1079080 to Mental Rush vs Vitality Rising Bees, so the earlier association is stale and not relied on. The current row's external price and source are shown on the match card.

flags.item: 4 Nations Week 1 overturned forfeits for Team Reds recorded correctly
flags.detail: A community-maintained Leaguepedia page reports two Week 1 Team Reds results as administrative forfeits for an ineligible roster. No Riot or organizer decision is linked here; treat the administrative cause as unverified, and do not interpret this historical note as an official ruling.

flags.item: Hotspawn displays the wrong name for the PvB slot in PRM 2nd Division
flags.detail: Hotspawn labels this team 'Phong Vũ Buffalo', but the five fixtures attributed to it (27 Oct 17:00 vs DKB XPERION NXT, 30 Oct 19:30 vs VfB eSports, 3 Nov 17:00 vs 404 Multigaming, 8 Nov 18:30 vs MT1 Esports, 13 Nov 18:30 vs regnum4games) are, in Leaguepedia, the five fixtures of 'PvB (Swiss Team)' in Prime League 2nd Division/2027 Season/Fall Split - same dates, same kick-off times, same opponents. The alias is therefore recorded explicitly in data/aliases.json with this evidence, not guessed. Hotspawn's card for these matches still shows the Vietnamese name and no logo.

flags.item: Hotspawn tier is blank for 171 of 241 fixtures in the current snapshot
flags.detail: The current fixtures API snapshot contains 241 scheduled LoL rows; 171 have a null tier value. The pipeline preserves the source field and does not infer a tier from competition names. This count is snapshot-specific and will change when Hotspawn updates its inventory.

flags.item: 10 of 241 current fixtures have an external market-based estimate
flags.detail: At the current snapshot, 10 of 241 fixtures matched a usable external market price in the feeds the collector checks. Venue coverage differs by match, including single-source cases; this does not establish that no other bookmaker offers a line. The remaining fixtures use historical Elo estimates or are quarantined, with method and limitations shown on their cards.

flags.item: Leaguepedia is a community wiki, not a Riot Games property
flags.detail: Leaguepedia is a community-maintained wiki, not a Riot Games property. Its series history is used as model input and may be incomplete or mislabeled. The Riot LoL Esports API is only a cross-check for the World Championship schedule in this pipeline; it is not a validation source for every national-league result.

flags.item: Elo ratings are only comparable inside one opponent graph
flags.detail: Ratings are fitted per league network. A team that never played a common opponent with its fixture opponent cannot be compared meaningfully; those matches are marked provisional with the 'no shared-opponent chain' note.

flags.item: List horizon extends past the 7-day pick'em window
flags.detail: The current Hotspawn snapshot includes fixtures through 2026-11-15, beyond the weekly pick'em horizon. All scheduled fixtures returned by the inventory feed are retained so the dashboard mirrors the current source list; later cards may change or be removed upstream.

flags.item: Hotspawn community pick percentages are stored but never used
flags.detail: The fixtures API exposes participants*_picked_percent. These values are persisted in data/raw/hotspawn_lol.json for transparency and are not read by the model, the picks, or any probability on the site.
